title: Marketing pitch: manage AI like a team you already know how to lead
description:
FILE ONLY until Ryan says go — do not edit Chattic.us-web marketing pages yet.

## Pitch north star
If you already know how to manage a team of people, those same collaboration skills let you be the boss of the AI — instead of worrying it will replace you.

Shift the whole marketing pitch a little toward **management transfer** (skills you already have as a people manager), not only “shared room / office / farm.”

## Repo
AnthusAI/Chattic.us-web (marketing site). Landing + supporting marketing pages. Not wiki/Thoughts desk work unless Ryan expands scope later.

## Where to apply first (when approved)
1. **Hero** (`components/Hero.tsx`) — keep brand line “Shared spaces for people and bots” if desired; rewrite subhead so the promise is management transfer, not only “office not chat.” Direction: you already know how to run a team; Chatticus is where you direct named AI teammates the same way (assign, review, approve) while the farm keeps working.
2. **Organization story** (`components/OrganizationStory.tsx`) — make the human the manager explicitly (e.g. “Several minds. One room. You still run the team.”).
3. **Use cases** (home `UseCases` + `/use-cases` / `page-content.ts`) — lean harder on org chart / desks you manage.
4. **FAQ** (`components/Faq.tsx`) — add plain “Will this replace me?” → No: it needs someone who can manage work; Chatticus is where those skills apply to AI teammates.
5. **Final CTA** (`components/FinalCta.tsx`) — shift from “a room of their own” toward “a team you can run.”
6. **Meta** (`app/page-content.ts`) — description/OG carry the manager pitch, not only shared computer.

Feature pages (`/features/*`) and `/beta` can stay mostly operational; emotional/job story belongs on home + use cases + FAQ.

## Out of scope for this chore
Live copy edits until Ryan says go. Thoughts/wiki interconnects are separate.

## Source
Ryan (2026-09-10) via Chatticus chat. Decision: file Kanbus backlog only.
